algorithm: PPO with a video-mined consensus grasp-pose auxiliary reward (R_pose) combined with an affordance reward (R_aff) and a lift-success reward (R_succ)
success_criterion: object lifted off the table for at least the last 50 time steps (a quarter of the episode length)
headline_metric: Grasp Success rate ablation (ContactDB objects, 100 episodes/object, 4 seeds)
headline_value: R_aff-only 60% -> +touch 63% -> +pose (full model, DexVIP) 68%; DexVIP outperforms COM/TOUCH/GRAFF/DAPG on all 4 metrics (Fig. 5); generalization to 11 non-ContactDB objects: DexVIP drops 68%->65% (4% relative) vs DAPG 59%->50% (15% relative drop)
human_data: curated HowTo100M video frames (715 frames, ~26 grasp images per object)
note_gaps: exact symbol-to-term binding among alpha/beta/gamma/eta in Eq. 1 is ambiguous in the extracted text; no code available to cross-check term implementation
operator_interface: no live operator; a consensus hand pose is mined offline from curated HowTo100M video frames via FrankMocap 3D hand-pose estimation and k-medoid clustering
retargeting_objective: deterministic 4-stage geometric mapping (not an optimization) from FrankMocap's 21-joint hand pose to Adroit's 30-DoF joint space, applied once offline to produce a single static consensus target pose per object category, used only as a reward target
